purpose: Authored, per-MT inputs that the Master Spec text does not determine mechanically (owning module, write scope, related MTs, trigger flags, model tier, red-team risks) for the spec-derived MTs promoted from the v02.226/v02.227 round trip. Everything else in each contract comes from the deriver output and the spec clause. Each owner is the crate or host module the clause itself names.
authored_by: round-trip and MT-contract agent, 2026-11-01, on the Operator request 'doe the spec's round trip and resolve issues with your agents. then generate the contracts'

MT-36252.title: Kumihimo as the single shared-controls owner: exact pinned revision, toolkit-free model, pure-Vulkan renderer crate
risks: A near-duplicate control mechanic or a fork of Kumihimo grows inside hsk-studio-controls
Dependency and source scan: hsk-studio-controls depends on the pinned Kumihimo revision and defines no parallel control model
The control model picks up a UI toolkit through the renderer
kumihimo-core and kumihimo-content resolve with no toolkit crate in their dependency closure; the renderer is a separate pure-Vulkan crate

MT-36253.title: render-gpu typed GPU client port to the central Handshake GPU owner; no Studio device ownership
risks: Studio code acquires or owns a GPU device beside the central owner
No device creation outside the port; the public API exposes no device acquisition or backend choice
The port's handle, admission, budget and retained-memory fields are invented before the GPU owner contract settles them
Fields stay a declared gap bound to Section 15; implementation stops at the gap rather than choosing values

MT-36254.title: Studio surfaces render in the native Vulkan shell; Studio product crates carry no UI toolkit or GPU abstraction layer
risks: A Studio product crate pulls in a UI toolkit or a separate GPU abstraction transitively
Workspace dependency-closure probe over every product crate fails on any toolkit or GPU-abstraction crate
A Studio clause or manual names a UI toolkit
Text scan of Studio-owned descriptors and manual entries for toolkit names

MT-36255.title: observe ring-shaped producer port into internal_diagnostics: codes, counters and opaque ids only, closed event-code mapping
risks: Text (paths, prompts, document content) leaks into the diagnostic ring
The producer type admits no string payload; a ring scan finds no text
An observe outcome maps to a code outside the closed set or to no code
Exhaustive mapping test over every terminal outcome; the allowlist table itself stays a declared Section 5.8 gap

MT-36256.title: Studio pane freeze and crash observed through Palmistry; 6.13 threshold and survivor-record schema read from the implementation until stated
risks: The 5 s threshold and SurvivorRecord shape are treated as spec facts
Recorded as UNVERIFIED implementation values per the clause; acceptance re-reads Section 6.13 when it gains ids
Freeze/crash proof uses a test double instead of the real application
Acceptance is the controlled owned freeze/crash of MT-36251 on the real application

MT-36257.title: Render callbacks never call the locking internal_diagnostics recorder; heartbeat and frame time only through the wait-free path
risks: A render callback reaches the mutex-taking record() path through a helper
Static call-graph check from every render callback plus a lock-instrumented run
A wait-free handoff is improvised before Section 5.8 specifies one
Declared gap; the callback records nothing until the wait-free path exists

MT-36258.title: One Settings tab 'Studio' with one subtab per setting-owning Studio module; namespace and Engine Profile fields held as declared gaps
risks: Studio claims a SET-SCOPE-001 namespace that does not admit tool defaults
Asset-local schema keeps namespace 'studio' marked spec_delta_pending until the spec owner decides
A module with no user-facing setting gets an empty subtab
Subtab set equals the set of modules that own a user-facing setting

MT-36259.title: ID bridge: controls Registry ids are the author_id space and the stable control ids; kernel-bindings Envelope carries client session, process birth and correlation
risks: Registry ids and author_ids drift into two id spaces
One id type shared by the Registry and the author_id field; a round-trip test over every registered control
Correlation identity is treated as authorization
Envelope fields are identity only; authorization stays with the host grant

MT-36260.title: Nothing Studio renders before account activation, previews and thumbnails included
risks: A thumbnail or preview renders through the pre-activation shell path
Pre-activation run asserts zero Studio render submissions, including thumbnail and preview workloads

risks: An asset-local transient-adapter GPU result is recorded as host acceptance
Every GPU proof record names its adapter; a transient-adapter record is labelled asset-local and cannot close a host acceptance row

Revision overflow or a stale expected revision commits
Checked successor arithmetic and stale-expected rejection tests
